reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis incorrectly assumes larger particles will increase thickness; in thermal spray, larger particles often have lower deposition efficiency due to incomplete melting and rebound, and the claim of reduced oxidation due to lower surface area is physically unsound because oxidation is controlled by in-flight time and temperature, not just surface-to-volume ratio.
reasons.testability: The proposed comparative experiment with clear metrics (thickness, oxidation, adhesion) and a specific falsification criterion is well-defined and feasible.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a flawed mechanism and would likely lead to wasted experimental effort; a researcher would be better served by exploring interventions that actually improve deposition efficiency.
